title: A concurrent duplicate while provisioning is in flight
prompt: The service atomically claims a key scoped by authenticated tenant before provisioning begins. A duplicate arriving while the first request is still running receives HTTP 409 and cannot start work. Event E1 is request A for tenant=acme, key=k-31, body={plan:pro}; it claims the key and remains in flight, so no HTTP response status has yet been generated. E2 is an identical request B arriving before A finishes; its 409 response reaches the client. E3 is A completing successfully with HTTP 201 and reference prov-31. For each event, report the actual server HTTP status (null if none has yet been generated or the scenario leaves it unknown), whether the client observed a response, business_effect_delta (new provisions), external_effect_delta, and response_ref (null if no completed resource response exists). Then report exactly provision_count and active_idempotency_records in final_state.
